audit.why: Difficulty EVEN fits the reported curve: Nami wins levels 1-3 on bubble/W sustain range, it's skill-dependent from 4 through first item, Milio pulls ahead at 2+ items via global range extension and cleanse.

audit.why: Aqua Prison (Q) ranks 12/11/10/9/8s; Tidal Wave (R) is 120/110/100s.
audit.corrected: See edits: breakdown.cooldowns now states both real cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: The missingInteraction was never stated: Nami sustains chip damage through Ebb and Flow (W) unless Milio times Grievous Wounds.
audit.why: Confirmed applicable and changes an itemization decision (anti-heal timing) beyond the general Helia line already in report[8].

edits.before: - Milio vs Nami - Track: Nami Aqua Prison. - Track his engage cooldown — your duo trades only when it's down. - The duo goes when Aqua Prison is down. - The R decides fights; it doesn’t advertise them.

edits.before: Spending the R on a single stun — the cleanse answers chains; chains wait for it to be gone.
edits.after: Trading heals for heals ignores your burn tax — every landed ability adds burn, so race the ledger.

edits.before: - Nami Aqua Prison: matchup-defining — The bubble starts every Nami play — sidestep it and her kit is small numbers. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your R Breath of Life answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Nami Aqua Prison (Q): 12/11/10/9/8s cooldown as she ranks it — sidestep it and her whole kit shrinks to small numbers; read it before every single duo step-up. - Her R Tidal Wave is 120/110/100s; bank your R for it, not for chip.

edits.before: You pull ahead in scaling fights: Milio's global R cleanse, huge range extension via Fired Up passive, and W attack-speed zone let your carry out-scale Nami's enchant, whose buffs don't extend range like yours.
edits.after: You pull ahead in scaling fights: Milio's global R cleanse, huge range extension via Warm Hearth passive, and W attack-speed zone let your carry out-scale Nami's enchant, whose buffs don't extend range like yours.

edits.after: Once items come online you take over: your global cleanse, Warm Hearth range extension, and W zone outscale her single-lane enchant kit in full 5v5 fights.

edits.before: Q-poke the contacts — the rebound catches the second body; bot stands in pairs.
